[SWS_PER_00530]
⌈
ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor::operator "«"
shall write the characters provided as ara::core::StringView to the file, over-
writing current content and advancing the end of the file if necessary. The position
shall be set to character following the last character that was written during this op-
eration, or to the end of the file. If an error occurs during this operation, the file
content might be partially updated and the resulting file position might not be as
expected.
⌋

[SWS_PER_00530]
⌈
ara::per::ReadWriteAccessor::operator<< shall write
the characters provided as ara::core::StringView to the file at the current po-
sition, possibly overwriting current content and advancing the end of the file if nec-
essary. The position shall be set to the character following the last character that was
written during this operation, or to the end of the file. If an error occurs during this
operation, the file content might be partially updated and the resulting file position
might not be as expected.
⌋
